response.reason: The frozen acceptance genuinely exercises the real candidate modules rather than source-string scans or exact-answer mocks, and its controls are non-vacuous. test_10 compiles the actual apps/web/frontend/lib/attention-key.ts and runs it in Node 20 and in real Chromium (Playwright 1.59.1) against a Python base64url oracle, so a Node-only Buffer codec or a lenient decoder fails; test_20 type-checks the actual attention-record.ts through the project tsconfig and proves the distributive mapped union (literal 'anomaly' narrows to counterparty_name, unknown-kind switch narrows each branch) while each @ts-expect-error (anomaly.market_reference, anomaly-rows-to-review-rows) is removed as an independent falsifier and must fail with a TS error (the weak-type TS2559 no-common-properties check makes the cross-kind row assignment a real error). The temporary isolated Next app imports the actual getAttentionRecord/@/lib/attention-key and drives backendRequest's real createBackendFetch (cookie forwarding, cache:no-store, redirect:manual) to a stateful ThreadingHTTPServer that logs method, raw once-encoded path and cookie and responds dynamically; test_30 mutates the producer data and asserts changed output, so hardcoded answers are impossible, and exact_hit asserts exactly one GET to the correct raw path, rejecting fallback/double-encoding/extra list hits. test_40 asserts the real Next 401 -> /login control flow as an actual 303/307/308 + Location:/login (not a JSON representation), which rejects any candidate that catches the redirect, and validates 403/404/503/Retry-After (valid delta-seconds and HTTP-date kept, malformed/negative -> null), 500 and connection failure as sanitized throws with SECRET and item_id never in the payload. test_50 covers wrong-id, malformed JSON, scalar/null/array envelopes, missing/extra keys, non-object rows and wrong scalar types all failing closed (500 + thrown, no leak) while empty/null/partial rows pass through unchanged. test_70 runs the real canonical API router + ReportingService(PUBLISHED) over the DuckPublicationStore under a signed local session and actually looks up slash/multirow/null records (grid/north above_market_average and d10 renewal are the two multi-row cases), and a bad session produces a real redirect. Setup is not masked: no conftest.py, no skips; require_modules asserts candidate presence (base b2 yields the expected 6 missing-module failures + 2 fixture passes, 0 skip); validate_report enforces exactly the 8 named cases with skipped/failures/errors all zero; Node v20 and Playwright 1.59.1 are version-asserted; process-group and owner-checked Docker cleanup are verified, not merely claimed. The mandatory CLI is the no-skip gate for the eventual native worker on the materialized candidate, not something meaningful to execute in this unmaterialized b2 clone where the modules and test file are absent. No gate is being waived.
response.trivial_pass: Concrete attack: a reader whose getAttentionRecord unconditionally awaits response.json() before branching on status would still pass every test, because every synthesized error body is valid JSON ({'detail': SECRET}). The test rejects the observable consequences (SECRET and item_id never appear in payloads; correct denied/not_found/unavailable mapping; exactly one hit) but does NOT directly falsify the 'check status before reading arbitrary error bodies' ordering: a malformed non-JSON error body is never synthesized, so a body-first reader is indistinguishable from a status-first reader. This is a minor, non-gate-breaking coverage gap (the security-critical properties are enforced). All stronger trivial-pass attacks are rejected: hardcoded/mocked answers fail the test_30 producer mutation and test_70 real-API lookup; any/unknown row types fail the test_20 @ts-expect-error falsifiers; a Node-only Buffer codec fails the browser run; catching the Next redirect fails the 303/307/308 + Location:/login assertion; number coercion fails exact decimal-string equality; fetching on invalid kind/key fails the hits==[] oracle (proven live by test_00's injected-request control).
checks: b2 checkout is canonical b2d0fe393ac0971e906cce275e91f45e94422593; apps/web/frontend/lib/attention-key.ts and attention-record.ts are absent and tests/test_attention_record_boundary_acceptance.py is not materialized (the frozen test exists only inside proposal.json's 'tests' string), so the mandatory CLI cannot meaningfully run here and its base behavior is the expected 6 missing-module failures + 2 fixture passes (test_00/test_60), 0 skips.

backend.ts is 1517 lines with createBackendFetch at 249, buildOperationPath at 307 and the exported backendRequest overloads from 335; components (interface, line 3837) and the four row schemas (TransactionAnomaliesRow, UpcomingFixedCostsRow, ContractReviewCandidatesRow, ContractRenewalWatchlistRow) exist in generated/api.d.ts and match the acceptance fixture_rows field-for-field (anomaly amount string and no currency; charge_id/market_reference/contract_duration_days optional-null).

test_10 executes the actual candidate codec: tsc compiles only attention-key.ts (commonjs, --types node, ES2022/DOM) and runs it under node with a Python base64url oracle and round-trip, plus a real Chromium page importing @/lib/attention-key; invalid inputs ('YQ==' padding, 'YR' noncanonical tail bits, 'a' impossible length, 'bad+' alphabet, '_w'/'wK8'/'7aCA' invalid UTF-8, empty/non-string, unpaired surrogates \ud800/\udc00) must decode to null and encode must throw TypeError, and kinds are checked via isAttentionRecordKind.

test_20 is semantically real, not a tool-error: the positive fixture compiles with @/lib/attention-record narrowing (literal 'anomaly'.counterparty_name, unknown-kind switch over all four kinds), and each of the two @ts-expect-error markers (anomaly.market_reference; anomaly rows assigned to review rows) is independently removed and required to fail with a TS error code, proving the distributive mapped union and cross-kind rejection.

test_30/40/50 drive a stateful synthetic producer: exact_hit enforces a single GET with the correct raw once-encoded path (urllib quote(safe='') matching encodeURIComponent) and forwarded cookie; producer mutation changes observed output; wrong-kind -> 404 not_found; invalid kind/key -> invalid with hits==[] (no fetch); 401 -> real 303/307/308 + Location:/login outside catch; 403 denied, 404 not_found, 503 unavailable with Retry-After only kept when a valid delta-seconds or HTTP-date and else null; 500 and network failure throw sanitized; malformed/wrong-id/non-object-row/wrong-scalar/extra-key 200s fail closed with SECRET and item_id never in the payload while empty/null/partial rows pass through.

test_70 is real local DuckDB API proof, not priming/stubs: it seeds/refreshes/publishes the canonical DuckPublicationStore, mutates market_reference to NULL, builds the real FastAPI app via _build_client with a signed homelab_analytics_session, serves it over uvicorn, and proxies the temporary Next boundary to it, asserting exact rows for selected slash IDs and the two multi-row records (review_grid/north_above_market_average, renewal_grid/north_d10) plus an invalid-session real redirect; it correctly does not claim Postgres/deployed qualification.

No collection masking: no conftest.py at repo root or tests/, pytest.ini only adds -m 'not slow' (the acceptance is unmarked so it runs), and validate_report asserts exactly 8 named cases with skipped/failures/errors zero; Node v20 (v20.) and Playwright 1.59.1 are version-asserted with clear hard failures, not skips.

Cleanup is verified not claimed: stop() SIGTERMs the process group, waits, then asserts killpg(0) raises ProcessLookupError (alive/ownership failure raises); the browser Docker fallback inspects the owner label, refuses mismatched owners, docker rm -f's, and re-checks the inventory; the signal handlers cover SIGINT/SIGTERM interruption before the cidfile is written.

Minor non-blocking gap: 'check status before reading arbitrary error bodies' is only indirectly enforced (no-secret-leak and correct status mapping) because all error bodies are valid JSON, so a body-first reader is not distinguished from a status-first reader; this does not let a fundamentally broken candidate through.
